overview_description.description:
CareerTu is an online learning platform for today’s most in-demand digital skills, starting with digital marketing, data analytics, and product design. We teach our students real-world business problems via capstone projects to make sure they are equipped with the must-have technical skills.

250+ top companies hired CareerTu students in 14 countries - including Google,  Facebook, Microsoft, Amazon, Spotify,  Pinterest, LVMH, TikTok, Expedia, Alibaba, Tencent, Meituan etc. 

CareerTu's mission is to teach students the industry’s most relevant and in-demand skills, making them the ideal hire at their dream companies, in return providing businesses with experienced and reliable talents to increase their efficiency.

华语数字化技能学习平台。通过系统学习高薪数字化技能, 迅速培养新兴行业紧缺的人，为中美科技和新零售企业不断输送优秀人才。


关注微信公众号CareerTu, 随时获得互联网和新零售行业最新资讯。
